label: scam
title: 'Amazon' says someone is using your account, refund via Bitcoin ATM
sources: FTC Data Spotlight Aug 2025: 'False alarm, real scam' -- accounts/SSN 'compromised'
FTC Data Spotlight Sep 2024: Bitcoin ATMs as a payment portal for scammers

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Amazon account security. Someone in another state just used your account to buy a $1,400 laptop.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The hacker also has access to your bank. We need you to move your money into a secure wallet before they empty it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Take out cash and feed it into the Bitcoin machine at the pharmacy. Do it now, and don't tell the bank, they may be compromised.
